context: Tests whether the agent understands the intentional boundary between stable resource attributes and invocation-scoped span/log attributes, correctly diagnoses missing invocation attributes on auto-instrumented spans, and uses an opt-in OpenTelemetry SpanProcessor without breaking trace export or metric cardinality.

checklist.name: Warm-container resource diagnosis
checklist.description: Explains that an OpenTelemetry resource is initialized once and reused by a warm container, so invocation IDs, deadlines, transaction IDs, and execution region would become stale if placed on it

checklist.name: Library-managed telemetry behavior
checklist.description: Recognizes that invocation attributes are expected on spans created through instrumentEntrypoint or instrument and on logs exported through getLogger

checklist.name: Auto-instrumentation boundary
checklist.description: Explains that direct OpenTelemetry and auto-instrumented spans do not receive the library's invocation attributes automatically, and identifies this as intentional thin-wrapper scope rather than broken configuration

checklist.name: Metric cardinality preserved
checklist.description: Explains that invocation attributes are intentionally absent from the resource and metrics to prevent a time series per invocation, and does not add them as metric attributes

checklist.name: Uses explicit invocation helper
checklist.description: Uses getAioRuntimeInvocationAttributes() to obtain current invocation attributes and does not use deprecated getAioRuntimeAttributes()

checklist.name: Custom SpanProcessor
checklist.description: Configures a custom OpenTelemetry SpanProcessor whose onStart hook sets the current invocation attributes on every recording span

checklist.name: Exporter processor preserved
checklist.description: Replaces traceExporter with spanProcessors containing both the custom attribute processor and an exporting processor such as BatchSpanProcessor wrapping the original trace exporter

checklist.name: Stable resource retained
checklist.description: Keeps getAioRuntimeResource() or another stable resource configuration and does not rebuild, mutate, or reinitialize the resource per invocation

checklist.name: Action handler left unchanged
checklist.description: Does not unnecessarily modify the correctly instrumented action handler or replace the existing getLogger and instrumentEntrypoint usage

checklist.name: Late background span caveat
checklist.description: Notes that unawaited work spanning invocation boundaries can be attributed to a later invocation when attributes are read as each span starts
